create.name: Murray Hidary
create.bio:
Murray Hidary is a composer, pianist and meditation teacher who founded MindTravel, a series of live music events built around mindfulness. Drawn to Zen Buddhism after reading Siddhartha at sixteen, he later took up Vedic Meditation, which he has practised for more than twelve years and now teaches: each student receives a personal mantra in a one-to-one session, followed by small group classes online or in person. Before music became his main work he was a technology entrepreneur and photographer, and he often mentions theoretical physics as one of the threads running through his compositions.

At a MindTravel event the audience wears wireless headphones while Hidary improvises at the piano, on beaches and in parks, in planetariums and theatres, and even for people floating in a pool; the format has visited more than a hundred cities, from Burning Man to a concert in Antarctica. His SilentWalk practice pairs music and spoken guidance with walking outdoors, and runs as a free monthly live session and as an audio membership. He has spoken at TEDx events in Berkeley and Sun Valley, and on Commune he teaches The Path to Presence, ten walking meditations that each explore one emotion.

courses.title: The Path to Presence
courses.description: A ten-day Commune course of walking meditations set to Murray's piano music, each one about thirty to forty minutes long and centred on a single common emotion. It suits people who find sitting still hard, and the walks can also be watched as filmed journeys.

courses.title: Learn Vedic Meditation with Murray Hidary
courses.description: A four-part course in Vedic Meditation: a private session in which you receive your mantra, then three group classes on how the technique works and on consciousness. It runs online and in person in Miami, New York and Los Angeles, with dates announced through the MindTravel mailing list.

courses.title: MindTravel SilentWalk Membership
courses.description: An on-demand library of guided audio journeys that combine Murray's original music with meditation and mindful walking. Listen at home, outdoors or while travelling; monthly and annual plans are offered.
courses.price: $8 USD per month ($88 USD per year)

courses.title: MindTravel Live-to-Headphones 'Silent' Piano Concerts
courses.description: Touring evenings in which the audience listens through wireless headphones while Murray improvises at the piano in a park, on a beach or in a theatre. Each gathering is framed as a shared, reflective experience; dates across the United States are listed on the events page.

free_resources.title: Monthly Virtual SilentWalk
free_resources.description: A free live online session on the first Monday of each month, in which Murray guides a walking meditation with music on a monthly theme. Join from wherever you can walk, or listen sitting down.

free_resources.title: Free Intro to Vedic Meditation
free_resources.description: A free introductory video in which Murray explains what Vedic Meditation is and how his course is structured. It is the first step before enrolling.
